reviews.text: WOW! This vet was EXCEPTIONAL. I usually get very stressed at the vet with my GSD (Ripley), but I felt extremely heard and the team was so intentional with Ripley. They even told me about happy visits (letting dog walk around hospital and hang with team to get used to place) and I love it. They had treats and toys and I really appreciated how accommodating they were to insure Ripleys comfort. I will definitely not ever be leaving this vet! Thank you so much!
Excellent

I love this veterinarian clinic. My Dog had become extremely itchy. She was miserable! I called in and was given appointment the next day. She normally sees Dr Cortez (who we love) but she was out of town so we had the pleasure of Dr Chang! She was thorough, calm and gentle with my dog.  My dog was given a cytopoint shot which has helped before and lasts for many months. They gave her the shot in the room with me which I prefer. My dog is much calmer when she is with me. She didn't even flinch. The place is clean and friendly. They have treats of all kinds for ever palette or allergie. Highly recommend.

Friendly, professional, knowledgeable. They give lots of love to your pet, answer all questions, and don't make you feel rushed. Great treats and they even let my dog choose a toy! 😊Got an appointment quickly. Lovely, clean facility. Easy to find. Parking was pretty easy to find.

I’m very disappointed. The staff and vets are nice enough people, but nice just isn’t enough for a veterinary office. They have little to no diagnostic equipment - even what tests they can do get sent out to a different office for review. The vets are doing literal guess work when it comes to what is happening and I have been turned away by them twice because they just plane don’t know what’s going on and by their own admission don’t have the resources to figure it out. You would only go here for them to charge and send you out on your way lost and scared, with no advice and struggling to figure out what to do. I honestly recommend skipping this place and taking pets to a full service pet hospital that can actually help instead of leave you with more questions than you came in with.
Thank you so much for the 5-star review, Jennifer! We truly appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you and your fur-babies again for their wellness visits!
The best vet in the valley! I’ve brought both our fur babies here and they take excellent care of them and everyone is always so professional and friendly. Dr. Chiang is the sweetest!

Southpaw Pets is truly the best veterinary clinic you could ask for, especially if you’re lucky enough to become part of their family.

We moved to California a few years ago, and finding someone you trust with your furry family member’s health can feel daunting when there are so many options. We were initially drawn to Southpaw because of the countless wonderful reviews about Dr. Chang, and after meeting her, we knew we had found the right place. But what I’ve come to appreciate most is that the care at Southpaw goes far beyond any one veterinarian.

The front desk staff, technicians, and entire team are incredibly attentive, compassionate, and genuinely caring. You can tell that they don’t simply see your pets as patients—they truly get to know and love them.

We recently had to make the incredibly difficult decision to put Sugar to rest. It was my first time going through something like this, and I was understandably terrified of the process. But the Southpaw team made an incredibly painful experience feel as gentle and comforting as it could possibly be. They never treated it like a transaction. They took their time, cared for Sugar with so much tenderness, and were incredibly compassionate toward me and my grief. Seeing how much they loved Sugar and how thoughtfully they cared for both of us meant more than I can put into words.

I should have written this review much sooner, but after seeing how they supported us during one of the hardest moments of my life, I really felt compelled to share how exceptional they are.

Thankfully, Sugar’s younger sibling is also part of the Southpaw family, so we know she is in the very best hands. My friend and her mom also bring their pets here, and I recommend Southpaw to everyone I know.

Thank you, Southpaw, for taking such wonderful care of our family and, most importantly, for loving Sugar so well. We will always be grateful.

I've been coming to Southpaw Vets since they opened and I have had a great experience every.single.time. I bring my dogs into the vet a lot (paranoid pet parent here) and they are always so kind, accommodating and patient (my dogs are weirdos at the vet). I really like being able to see availability and book on their website, but also being able to call or text with questions. We primarily see Dr. Braham and Dr. Chiang and they are both so wonderful. I am so grateful to have a vet that consistently provides us with such attentive care. We even drive from Santa Monica to come here! If you are looking for a new vet, I highly recommend Southpaw!

Southpaw as a group, has the best vets and staff I have ever had and I have had many.  This is a very competent, smart,  kind group to both dogs and owners.  I am so glad a friend referred me to them.  I don't feel over charged or asked to do tests that aren't completely necessary.  Thank you, Southpaw.
Southpaw Vets is where my Yorkies go, it’s the best veterinary clinic in the Valley. We see Dr Connie Chung and always appreciate her knowledge. They are all great! Thank you!
Dr Connie is the best; during the exam, you can tell the immense love she has for animals 🤘🏼 …
Thank you so much for your kind support, Austin.

I wanted to update my review because ‘best vet in LA’ simply doesn’t capture the level of expertise and love you receive at Southpaw Vet.

First I have to give a shout to the women at the front desk. They are among THE most thorough, organized, compassionate, and genuinely kind people I’ve ever encountered in any business. Every interaction is met with warmth and a sincere desire to help.

After moving to Los Angeles, it took us 2 years to find a vet we trusted. Our pit bull Osito was the most accident prone dog we’ve ever had. If there was an infection, random injury, or a health issue to be found, Osito would find it. At over 100 pounds the staff knew exactly how to handle him and always treated him with patience and respect .

Our 17 yr old Chihuahua Kennedy, suffered from severe anxiety and the staff always knew how to make her feel safe. The level of individualized care they provided for both of our dogs was truly wonderful.

Southpaw cared for our dogs as if they were their own and that kind of dedication is rare IMO. I cannot recommend them highly enough.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about this vet team at Southpaw. I have 2 senior dogs with multiple health issues, I've spent a lot of time here and the level of care we receive is truly exceptional.

From the moment you walk through the door, everyone treats both you and your pet with genuine kindness and compassion. The entire staff goes above and beyond to make what can often be stressful situations feel manageable and supported.

The office is incredibly efficient and responsive as well! They always get back to me quickly, answer my questions, and make me feel like my concerns matter.

The doctors are knowledgeable, transparent, and take the time to explain diagnoses, treatment options, and next steps in a way that is easy to understand. I never feel rushed and always feel confident that my dogs are receiving the best possible care. Which as a type A dog mom... is SO crucial to me.

The vet techs are equally amazing too! Patient, helpful, and so caring with my pups. Their attention to detail and willingness to help in any way they can makes such a difference.

Its my first time caring for senior dogs which can be challenging and so stressful, but this team has been there for me and my babies every step of the way. I am beyond grateful for their entire team for the expertise, compassion, and dedication. I have personally recommended them to friends and family and everyone has been so happy with them so I can wholeheartedly recommend them to anyone looking for a vet!

I would like to personally thank the following for taking such a huge part in Max and Toby's health journey :
Dr. Braham, Dr Chiang, Molly, Karla V, Alondra, Elsy.
We are so grateful for your support, Teri! Thank you!
We are grateful for your trust and support, Jeremy!
Thank you for trusting us with your pet's care, Bree.

I have been to this vet for physicals for my kitty Holly.  We saw Dr. Cortez every time.  She is a compassionate skillful talented vet and listens and responds mindfully to my cat and myself needs for Holly.  She will sit and listen to every question,  spends time with you.

Recently,  we had a whole work up done on Holly blood xray, etc.  She explained everything and showed me the test results.  She is a very good expert.

The rest of the staff are very attentive and kind as well.

Coming from massachusetts with Holly not knowing anyone here,  it's a real relief and treasure to find such a caring and welcoming,  also knowledgeable vet and facility in so cal.

Since adopting my cat a few years ago, I felt like I hadn’t really been able to find a vet that I absolutely loved. After reading all of the highly rated reviews about Southpaw, I decided to make an appointment and I am so, so glad I did. They are genuinely the BEST. Everyone is so kind and reassuring, from the front desk to the techs to the vets. My sweet boy had to get all of his teeth extracted, and I trusted them completely, even after only being there once before! Dr. Cortez, along with the techs and the front desk staff, talked me through absolutely everything and were just so gentle and patient and amazing. After his surgery, they gave him a certificate of bravery…. LIKE HOW CUTE IS THAT. I love this place and feel so safe here with my bubba!

Love this place! They have been taking great care of our little Multipoo since we got her just over 2 years sgo. The vets are excellent and the staff are always friendly. They have been great in dealing with our anxious bundle of joy and keeping her healthy.

This is hands-down, the best place to go! I love that the vets and techs speak to the dogs like children with a soothing voice. I feel like this place has a level of professionalism that meets the heart when A lot of other Places are missing the love/warmth factor. They always have toys for my pups and treats ready to go. One of my dogs is quite shy, and I usually have to ask for treats at other vets. However, south paws Has an excellent level of attunement and hospitality to meet your dogs needs making the experience seamless and even fun for them. My dogs highly recommend this place 10 bones out of 10
Disappointed that when you call you don't even speak to a real person anymore. Entire conversation with an AI scheduler. This is what is wrong with the world. You are the problem.
The best vet experience I’ve ever had - they’re on your side and your pets, truly great care partners and wonderful experience.
Thank you so much for your kind support, Mel!
We are so grateful for your support, Tiffany!

My first visit with my new cat and they were on time, listened to all my concerns and were so sweet with my kitty. She was unsure of the environment but they were all so nice to her. They were transparent about pricing and even sent me a quote for a service afterwards. Scheduling online was super easy with great communication. Will be bringing my kitty back for services here.

What a strange thing I am doing, but there is a review below an S.B. It’s a one star review, but it appears to be accidentally one star because the reviewer is describing all sorts of entitled and inconsiderate behavior on her part and  Detailing how the Office try to fit her Despite a jammed schedule -didn’t waste time with small talk, but proceeded to give her pet medical care immediately and behave professionally with a good attitude despite her lack of gratitude or humility.
That sounds five star to, me.

We moved from the Bay Area 4 months ago and we were looking a reliable place to stablish care for our senior chi. I’m so relieved that we found southpaw.
The team is very caring. Prices are disclosed on the website so you have an idea how much you expect the spend on the visit. They also present an estimate and there is no push for you to do it all - they talk to you about the plan and alternatives and steps for the treatment plan.
So far, my chi had 3 visits. She had to stay for 8 hours to do testing and they updated me with pictures.
I’m always worried about my dog and trying to do the best I can. They are patient, answer all questions, and deals well with my human “anxiety “.

Here is update Jan 2026:
Sadly last month we relocated from LA to Illinois. We will miss immensely the care from this team. My Junebug had a horrible allergic reaction and they promptly squeezed us in. They just go above and beyond.
Funny or not she has a huge chart. Whenever a new members reads they say “wow”. My girl is healthy and despite some care and I just cannot appreciate them more.
Yes, sometimes some inconveniences happens, but we are all humans.
I highly recommend and I wish I had a southpaw here in Illinois!

Update Dec 2026: Still the best. Cashew cannot wait to get inside. They love pups.

Original: Best vet in LA, no doubt.

Extremely caring vets, techs, and office staff that bring joy to those that are suffering and can't help themselves. I would travel around the world to get this quality of care. Unreal how good they are.
they’re super patient with my fearful dog! they’re also very responsive via email and text. highly recommend

Unfortunately I want to say I had a good experience with this vet but I did not. Before deciding where to go for my dog’s TPLO surgery, I called many vets for pricing, Southpaw vet being 1 of them. When I called Southpaw, the front desk reassured me MULTIPLE times that the price was $4,000 which included blood work and post-op x-rays. I went in having faith they will keep their word on the price. After going in pay I paid $77 for exam, $250 blood work and $300 for chest x-rays. I spent a total of  $754 for pre-surgery items. They quoted me $5,000+ for the surgery and addition cost for post surgery x-rays. They did not keep their word. I ended up paying $600+ more than going to other vets that granted cheaper prices because the front desk encouraged me and gave me hope. Unfortunately, I will not be coming back here. There’s a big miscommunication with the front desks and vet on prices. We has pet owners should not be spending thousands just to get the proper care for our pets who are like family.

Apparently, Michelle is a very sensitive person who, instead of handling feedback professionally and focusing on customer satisfaction, chose to send me a termination-of-services email. They don't have twenty minutes to examine a cat with an eye infection, but they somehow have time to terminate clients. I'm honestly relieved my business with them is over - their attitude says everything about how little they care about their clients.
I went to Sherman Oaks Veterinary Group instead, and within thirty minutes they saw my pet and took care of everything. While Southpaw seems more focused on replacing staff with Al and maintaining their attitude, real vets are still out there doing their jobs with care and professionalism. Don't waste your time with them - prioritize your pet's health!

The absolute BEST vet I have ever been to with my three babies. I think I have seen every doctor there and they are all caring and extremely intelligent. I rarely wait in the waiting room. It’s immaculate and the office staff are SO nice. You can tell they love animals. I fully trust them.

Issue after issue here. Looks like I'll need to find a new vet. The front desk was rude when I called to see if there was availability today. I asked who I was speaking to and she pretended like she couldn't hear me and that the call cut out, all to avoid telling me her name . Rude service is my largest complaint. They are pretty bad about returning calls and after today's visit where the vet tech didn't even say hi to my scared dog at all, he just went  to touch my dogs face wound without gloves, making her feel even more afraid. I dared bring that up to the vet, just to let  her know that her techs should take 10 seconds to say hi to the dog and let the dog smell them before going in for their face. She was full of attitude saying "that's my fault, I squeezed you in because I thought this was urgent." Her tone implied that clearly she did not believe this was urgent, even though I never said it was.  I moved my previously set appointment from Thur to Tuesday since I wanted them to look at a scratch on her face to see if she needed stitches or not, because I am not a vet so I have no clue what was needed.  I wasn't aware that I was being "squeezed in." They called me back saying there was a 2:45 appointment available and I took it, not knowing that I would be getting rushed and rude service. This vet is not inexpensive, so without good customer service, I don't feel it's worth it. The people caring for your pets should be kind and have good bedside manner. That's just bare minimum. I told the vet I saw today about the issues and she seemed defensive instead of having a willingness to make me feel better about any of this, so needless to say, I will not be back. Moving forward, listen to constructive criticism with care and curiosity instead of rudeness and defensiveness. Had I felt heard, I would not have taken the time out of my day to write a negative review.

Previous to today, I called asking questions about having something done with my dog and I wanted to know the cost and what the recovery time would be. They said someone would call me back Friday or Monday. I called Thur and never got a call back. A week later I had to call back and had to flag the manager down to get an answer. Though they seemed to care when I brought this to their attention, today's experience is directly following that one- so I give up.

*The wound on my dog's face that the vet was not concerned about yesterday has completely opened up again and it's back to being the deep flap- wide open. They couldn't pay me to come back!
Thank you so much for your review, Chris! We’re glad you found our pricing fair and appreciate your support.

I cannot say enough good things about Southpaw Vets -- we've been seeing Dr. Cortez for a few months now for our sweet senior dog and the level of care has been outstanding. From the reception desk to the vet techs to the doctors, every single person we've interacted with has been kind, compassionate, and skilled.

They're incredibly responsive -- whether it's a text or phone call, we always get a speedy reply and if your doctor isn't in that day, one of the others will step in seamlessly to help. Our dog has had a few health issues and they've always walked us through every step, counseled us regarding what's important versus more of a nice to have, and take great pains to ensure she gets the absolute best care possible.

We're so grateful to have found such a fantastic team. Highly recommend to anyone who wants their pet cared for like family!
They’re awesome! Thanks!! Our Shih Tzu had a digestion issue, and it was fully resolved after the first appointment and probiotics prescribed!

Great vets and techs, clean and calm waiting room, prices are fair, as in they provide quality service and request a fee that is worth that service but don't over charge.

I also appreciate that I never feel pressured to pay for more services or that they are trying to "slip" something extra in there. I  once brought my dog in because he was limping and was ready to pay for x rays, however the vet suggested just keeping him off the paw for a bit and letting him rest first to see if that fixed it instead of immediately dropping a couple hundred bucks for Xrays.

Always clean, friendly and professional. I'm happy we found Dr. Chiang and her staff.
We've been going to Southpaw for almost 3 years, and our experience is consistently pleasant.
Most recently, my dog Piggy was there on July 31, 2025 for blood work, a dental, a small mass removal, and updated vaccines.
They took care of her like she was a queen and kept me notified the whole time via text including pics.
Before taking Piggy home, they reviewed her aftercare with me as well. They're available via text for any questions and respond quickly.
A++
Thank you for the 5 stars, Keith! We appreciate your support!

I love this place and their attendants, they work well with my big dog and have been very understanding and kind with us! Such a vast improvement from our last vet experience at a nearby competitor! (BF). 🌟🌟🌟🌟💯💜❣️

After searching for a good vet I finally found one..first visit was awesome so far.. glad I came here for my puppy.  Great vibes, understood my puppy's needs, and fair price especially for the area! Thank you all!

I would give 100 negative stars if possible. This clinic has severe medical negligence and now refusing to pay for their incompetence.

My cat came for a simple PCR test. Should have been 10 min, in and out. But instead, either the incompetent vet or tech somehow let my cat bite off a 2 inch chunk of plastic swab and SWALLOW IT! So from a PCR test on my 18 year old cat, I then had to rush him to an emergency vet to get an endoscopy. Though the urgency of the case must not have been relayed by the vet because it wasn’t done for 4+ hours letting the swab enter his intestines putting him at GREAT risk of surgery and massive complications. He went under anesthesia and an invasive procedure for nothing. He then went 35+  hours without relieving himself causing massive distress and physical pain. Finally after contacting his regular vet, they advised a little laxative to get it moving. Hours later, the 2 inch spike that made its way through my cat’s gastrointestinal tract made its way out.

Well, the following evening, he started vomiting, a lot. Every hour to hour and 1/2. Now they footed the bill for the endoscopy. But guess what… they’re refusing to pay the bill for the $1300 for urgent care that should have NEVER HAPPENED IN THE FIRST PLACE! They want me to bring him back to their clinic. There is no way I’m trusting those doctors to touch my cat again. It was already agreed upon he’d see another vet for further care and that they’d pay. But now that I’m sitting here urgent care, with a once perfectly healthy cat, and they stick me with the bill. This will be proceeding to court.

DO NOT - IF YOU CARE FOR YOUR PET’S HEALTH AND WELL BEING - COME TO THIS CLINIC!

Dr. Connie Chiang, Carolina and the whole team at Southpaw are fantastic! They're the most caring people and excellent at what they do. They understand reactive dogs, go above and beyond to answer questions, never make you feel rushed, have treats on deck, and are gentle, knowledgable and kind. I honestly can't say enough good things about them and the love they have shown Gauge, Punky, and our whole family.

Dr. Chiang and the team at Southpaw are the most caring, sensitive, empathetic crew. I have had two cats and two dogs who are patients with them, each with their own unique medical quirks, and I’ve found that Dr. Chiang will be honest about the pros and cons of all treatments and will always recommend the most economical option first with options for more expensive treatments explained as well. There is no doubt in my mind that the staff at Southpaw loves and animals and does their best to provide humane, affordable treatment.

Every Pet owner will appreciate the kindness and care the entire staff shows toward anyone and their pet who is lucky enough to find this gem. Dr Shim takes her time with my dog and me, explains all issues clearly and will not do unnecessary test, even if I suggest it. I would not go anywhere else for all my pet needs. They are all knowledgable and truly care.

Wow, this is the best animal hospital I’ve been to, and I’ve been in the animal hospital field for 10 years! It’s far from me, but worth the drive. From the start, the front desk was kind and helpful, and the hospital itself is clean and welcoming!

My cat has been sick for a while, and at his old vet, even with gabapentin the day before and the day of his appointment, it still wasn’t enough to make treatment easy. This time, with just one dose and a same-day appointment, Dr. Chiang was so patient that my cat was calm enough for x-rays! I really appreciate the little touches like Feliway in the room, heated mats, and treats, which made a huge difference.

Prices are amazing for the quality of care! I was paying almost double at my other vet. If you’re not loving your current vet, give this hospital a try—it might become your new favorite too!
Thank you so much for the 5-star rating, Angela! We appreciate your support.
Thank you, Brad! Your support means a lot to our team.

Truly pleased with Southpaw Vets!! Everyone is super friendly and Dr. Shim is fabulous!! Our pittie is always treated like a king👑 We’ve done general visits along with a dental procedure and throughout the entire process of the procedure, they were very communicative and very sweet to our boy. Also our pup always leaves with a new toy which is a special touch!! Glad we can call this place home and 100% recommend to anyone. (And already have lol!!)
The staff is always very friendly and accommodating. They are fast, efficient, and communicative. Highly recommended.

This is where to go if you’re looking for a caring, kind, and passionate vet. My cat is so anxious about unfamiliar situations; everyone was thoughtful and caring. Also, the communication is outstanding. You receive updates on whether you have to leave your pet there, and the aftercare was excellent. You can get back with all your questions and always get an answer even if the treatment plan has already ended. It’s not a business for them; everyone is very passionate about what they are doing, which means so much to me as a pet owner.

We travel 18 miles each way through traffic so our beloved cat Ozzie can be seen by Dr. Shim at Southpaw Vets. We used to live a lot closer & moved, but we keep seeing Dr. Shim because we know she'll take great care of our furry four legged son. Thank you Dr. Shim and Southpaw Vets!
I cannot express enough how much I love this vet. Everyone here is so very kind. I always have a good experience when I bring my pets.

After 4 years of trying different Vets I've finally found this place which I'm extremely satisfied and happy. The staff is very sweet and genuine. Dr. Linda Shim  is excellent and genuine,honest and kind.  I feel  so lucky and grateful. Words can't describe how I feel. Also Morgan is so sweet and loving also professional. Today was my second time and I will continue going there. Please take your babies to Southpaw. Thank you everyone for treating me so kindly!

It's hard to overstate how incredible this veterinary practice is. We found our home here after an intense tail injury lead us to jumping between three separate vets who all provided subpar care and zero helpful answers as we navigated our kitty's pain and anxiety before we were told about Southpaw. And we are so grateful to have found them!  Dr. Braham and every other wonderful person who works here has taken the most amazing care of our sweet girl, Ivy, and I've never felt more heard and supported when it comes to her care.

We recently wanted to get Ivy in on very last minute notice to have her checked for a UTI  before going out of town, and the admin staff were amazing at updating me on when existing appointments cancelled so that I was able to get her in the SAME day I called-- incredible considering how popular and valued appointments are with Dr. B. Not only that, but I rarely wait more than a few hours for the admin staff or Dr. B to respond to any emails or questions I've sent along to them.

We will drive Ivy in heavy rush hour traffic from Silverlake to Sherman Oaks any day to continue to see this amazing team. We are so grateful to have them as a part of our lives!
The people working here are kind and committed. They communicate well. I recommend Southpaw Vets!
Thank you so much for the 5-star review, Garett! We truly appreciate your support and are glad to have had the opportunity to assist you and your pet.
We really appreciate the 5-star review, Rex! Thank you for trusting us with your pet's care.
Love this place, they don’t make you do tests based on our kitty’s history and I’m a southpaw too!
Thank you for the 5-star rating, Susan! We're grateful for your support and happy to have had the opportunity to care for your pet.

I cannot say enough good things about Southpaw Vets and especially about Dr. Chiang. I have taken both of my cats to see Dr, CViang for various issues. In all instances she provided excellent care and, most importantly, great follow up. Her post-visit communications are very detailed and helpful. She's the best veterinarian I have ever dealt with. The office personnel is also very pleasant and efficient.

I took my cat, Lolita, in for a pretty serious hysterectomy. This was my first ever pet emergency, and I was really nervous. Having been to three different animal hospitals, I am beyond grateful and over the moon that the procedure happened here at South Paw Vets. A truly beautiful space, with the kindest and sweetest staff. Melanie was so careful and sweet with Lolita, and very reassuring and thorough with me about the process. I received text updates throughout the entire process. This could have been a nightmare situation, but it was nothing but a blessing. Dr. Chiang is the best out there

I have had a wonderful experience at South Paw Vets. Dr. Chiang, Dr. Barham, and the entire staff are truly fantastic—knowledgeable, compassionate, and dedicated. I really appreciate that they never push unnecessary tests or costs, focusing instead on providing thoughtful, personalized care for my two cats. I also value that this is a family-owned veterinary hospital. Their honest and professional approach has earned my complete trust, and I highly recommend South Paw Vets to anyone seeking a trusted veterinarian.

I came to this vet by a recommendation from Jess Rona grooming in Larchmont. And my experience here with Southpaw Vet was WOW!

When I called to book, they had availability immediately for the next day as I was in need for an appointment ASAP. Was told they also have online booking available to view other time slots if I wanted to book that way for future reference. It was a swift booking via phone. Ample parking in the back of building  was nice.

Everyone I interacted with were so nice and caring! The front receptionist in the middle with pink scrubs was very nice and handed us a bandana with their signature calming spray on it while we waited.

The waiting area is modern, spacious and CLEAN.  Very nice touch with the picture decor and a nice little refreshment bar of coffee, tea and water. They had a TV playing which was nice to distract and pass time than be on my phone.

The first assistant took us to the room and took all the important information about my senior dog and the concern for the visit. I didn't feel rushed when talking about my concerns. When Dr. Connie Chiang entered the room, it wasn't a long wait from the first assistant to Dr. Connie, unlike other vet clinics.

Dr. Connie is super awesome and genuinely caring and listened to my concern.  She was thoroughly informed by the first assistant and I felt relieved because I could discuss more in detail of my concerns. She spent quite a bit of time with us answering my questions and explaining what the next steps are. I never felt this much attention to my senior baby. And again, not once did I feel rushed with the vet, Dr. Connie. Loved how my senior pup slept during our consultation.  🩶

Then I met her two assistants, Amy and Molly. They are amazing, very caring and informative like Dr. Connie!! They answered my concerns and if they didn't know the answer they immediately went to ask and was back in a few mins.

One thing that truly stood out, is how they all sit down and take the time to talk to you. That really made the relationship between pet parents and the staff. I will definitely be back to see Dr. Connie Chiang and her staff!

Update: 9/11/2023
Everyone here are still amazing! Come here regularly for LED Laser treatment for my dog's arthritis. Definitely see a big difference in her walk. Thank you!

Update: 2/17/2025
Dr. Connie and staff are still the Best! With a new puppy, I only trust Southpaw Vets & staff. They are always so responsive via text, emails, and calls. Always the best care from puppy to senior pets. We will always come back to Southpaw.
Thanks for the rating, Erling! We’re grateful for your support and look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon!

They really take their time addressing your pets needs while also being considerate of their stress. Our dog is an absolute nutcase but they try to accommodate her as much as possible which I greatly appreciate. They also don't come across like some vets where you feel like they're just after your wallet.
Thank you for the review! We’re so glad you had a great visit. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again soon! 🐾 …
Thank you so much for the 5 stars, Nitzan! We truly appreciate your support and are glad to have had the opportunity to care for you and your pet.

Super clean office and friendly doctors and staff. They really go above and beyond. I moved to a different part of town and already miss this vet office. I refer everyone I know to them! I couldn’t believe it when they made this custom surgery suit when my kitten go spayed. They go the extra mile!
